name: get_supplier
description: Look up one supplier by supplier id (SUP-CERES, SUP-TITAN, SUP-EUROPA, SUP-PHOBOS, SUP-ARMOR) or by the SKU they supply. Returns lead time, rating, contact and contract expiry.

sku.description: Alternatively, a cargo SKU such as ION-COIL-7

name: list_suppliers
description: List suppliers, optionally filtered by category (propulsion, navigation, life-support, fuel, structural).
